verdict.rationale: The CLI docs say you can 'explore the API interactively — discover endpoints, preview requests, and inspect schemas', and the CLI and Developer MCP can call sandbox endpoints, so live requests against a safe environment are possible. This interactive exploration runs through the CLI and agent tooling, not through an interactive API reference with embedded runnable examples. Missing for 10: a documented interactive web API reference, in-page runnable request examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
